newsitem.title: DUBAI: Dubai plans $400 mln oil refinery in Jebel Ali.
newsitem.headline: Dubai plans $400 mln oil refinery in Jebel Ali.

text.p: Dubai is planning to build a $400 million oil refinery in the Jebel Ali Free Zone, a UAE domestic fuel retailer said, as quoted by the official WAM news agency on Thursday.

Hussein Sultan, executive director of the Emirates Petroleum Products Company (EPPCO), said the UAE's Finance and Industry Minister Sheikh Hamdan bin Rashid al-Maktoum had announced the refinery project, WAM said.

"(Hussein) said his excellency is looking for a speedy realisation of the project," WAM reported. "It is expected that the first phase will be completed in the first quarter of 1998 at a cost of $200 million."
WAM gave no further details on the size of the proposed plant.
OPEC member UAE is becoming a regional refining centre with the expansion of its Ruwais refinery in Abu Dhabi and privately financed refinery plants.
